decisions.reason: A hearty bread loaf is a low-cost addition to a bakery's core range and has stayed on the market for two years, so keeping the option open costs little.
Sweet pastries are cheap to produce alongside existing lines, and the product's continued presence suggests acceptable demand, so there is no strong signal to abandon it.
A farmhouse bread uses the existing ovens and staff at minimal extra cost, so the firm keeps it while its prospects are still uncertain.
The gold award and its own web page show its value has been realized, which justifies further commitment to this seasonal product.
A gold-awarded premium stollen is a proven, high-margin seasonal product with little uncertainty left, so the firm keeps it.
